Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly identified Gillian Anderson as the host of the 18th Independent Spirit Awards in 2002 based on the search results. While the search results mentioned that Gillian Anderson hosted the awards, they also clarified that the ceremony took place on March 22, 2003, honoring films from 2002. This indicates that Gillian Anderson hosted the awards for the year 2002, but the event itself occurred in 2003. The error lies in conflating the year of the films honored (2002) with the year of the ceremony (2003). The task specifically asked for the host of the awards held in 2002, not the awards honoring films from 2002.
